description: This file defines a RunRegistry type and a factory function to create and manage a registry of run records, including methods for adding, retrieving, updating, finalizing, and deleting run records, with internal logic for pruning exited records.

methods.name: createRunRegistry
methods.description: Factory function that creates a RunRegistry object with methods to manage run records, including adding, retrieving, updating, finalizing, and deleting records.

methods.name: resolveMaxExitedRecords
methods.description: Function to determine the maximum number of exited records to keep, with a default fallback.
